lesson.title: 连续性
lesson.description: 7 个知识点、10 道教材例题与全部 69 道节后习题，含双语分步解析与逐例题对应练习。

en.title: Continuity
en.description: 7 concepts, all 10 textbook examples, and all 69 section exercises, with bilingual step-by-step solutions and method-based exercise links.

source.title: James Stewart · Calculus: Early Transcendentals, 7th Edition

concepts.title: 连续性的三个条件与间断类型
concepts.summary: 在 $a$ 连续要求 $f(a)$ 有定义、$\lim_{x\to a}f(x)$ 存在且等于 $f(a)$。可去间断可通过只改变该点的值修补；跳跃间断左右有限极限不同；无穷间断没有有限极限。

method.title: 检查函数值
method.body: 从原式或实心点确定 $f(a)$。

method.title: 比较两侧
method.body: 计算左右极限；相等才有双侧极限。

method.title: 判断能否修补
method.body: 有限共同极限等于函数值才连续；若只缺值或值不符，可把 $f(a)$ 改成共同极限。

pitfalls: $\infty$ 不是有限实数极限；在点上补一个数不能修补无穷间断。
约分后仍保留原函数缺失的点。

en.title: The continuity test and types of discontinuity
en.summary: Continuity at $a$ requires a defined $f(a)$, an existing limit $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)$, and equality of the two. A removable discontinuity can be repaired by changing one value; a jump has unequal finite one-sided limits; an infinite discontinuity has no finite limit.

method.title: Check the value
method.body: Read $f(a)$ from the original rule or filled point.

method.title: Compare both sides
method.body: Compute the one-sided limits; a two-sided limit requires equality.

method.title: Test or repair continuity
method.body: Continuity requires the common finite limit to equal $f(a)$. A missing or incorrect value can be replaced by that limit.

pitfalls: $\infty$ is not a finite real limit; assigning one value cannot repair an infinite discontinuity.
Cancellation does not fill a hole in the original domain.

concepts.title: 单侧连续与闭区间端点
concepts.summary: 右连续要求 $\lim_{x\to a^+}f(x)=f(a)$，左连续要求 $\lim_{x\to a^-}f(x)=f(a)$。在闭区间 $[a,b]$ 连续，内部用双侧连续，左端用右连续，右端用左连续。

method.title: 定位方向
method.body: 只能从定义域内趋近端点。

method.title: 分别对照
method.body: 每个单侧极限分别与 $f(a)$ 比较。

method.title: 写清区间
method.body: 端点属于定义域且满足相应单侧连续时用方括号。

pitfalls: 左右极限相同但不等于函数值时，两侧都不连续。

en.title: One-sided continuity and endpoints
en.summary: Right continuity means $\lim_{x\to a^+}f(x)=f(a)$; left continuity means $\lim_{x\to a^-}f(x)=f(a)$. On $[a,b]$, use two-sided continuity inside, right continuity at $a$, and left continuity at $b$.

method.title: Locate the permitted side
method.body: Approach an endpoint from within the domain.

method.title: Compare separately
method.body: Compare each one-sided limit with $f(a)$.

method.title: Specify intervals
method.body: Use a closed endpoint when it belongs to the domain and the appropriate one-sided limit agrees.

pitfalls: If the one-sided limits agree with each other but not the value, neither side is continuous.

concepts.title: 连续函数的运算与定义域
concepts.summary: 连续函数的和、差、常数倍、积仍连续；商还要求分母不为零。多项式处处连续；有理、根式、三角、反三角、指数、对数函数在各自定义域内连续。

method.title: 从原式列限制
method.body: 分母不能为 $0$；偶次根号内非负；对数真数严格正；反正弦输入在 $[-1,1]$。

method.title: 取限制的交集
method.body: 同时满足所有限制才在定义域内。

method.title: 运用连续性
method.body: 在定义域内可用 $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)=f(a)$，保留端点趋近方向。

pitfalls: 分母中的平方根要求根号内严格大于零。

en.title: Continuity laws and domains
en.summary: Sums, differences, constant multiples, and products of continuous functions are continuous. A quotient also needs a nonzero denominator. Polynomials are continuous everywhere; rational, root, trigonometric, inverse trigonometric, exponential, and logarithmic functions are continuous on their domains.

method.title: List original restrictions
method.body: Exclude zero denominators, require nonnegative even-root radicands and positive logarithm arguments, and keep arcsine inputs in $[-1,1]$.

method.title: Intersect the restrictions
method.body: All restrictions must hold simultaneously.

method.title: Apply continuity
method.body: Within the domain use $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)=f(a)$, respecting endpoint directions.

pitfalls: A square root in a denominator requires a strictly positive radicand.

concepts.title: 复合函数连续与连续函数中的极限
concepts.summary: 若 $g(x)\to b$ 且 $f$ 在 $b$ 连续，则 $f(g(x))\to f(b)$。若 $g$ 在 $a$ 连续且 $f$ 在 $g(a)$ 连续，则 $f\circ g$ 在 $a$ 连续。

method.title: 分辨内外函数
method.body: 先确定内层输出是否落在外层定义域。

method.title: 先求内层极限
method.body: 如遇 $0/0$，先约分或有理化，再得有限值 $b$。

method.title: 检查外层连续
method.body: 在 $b$ 连续后，代入外层求 $f(b)$。

pitfalls: 外层有定义不自动证明复合函数的全部定义域。
教材中反三角函数使用弧度。

en.title: Composition and limits through a continuous function
en.summary: If $g(x)\to b$ and $f$ is continuous at $b$, then $f(g(x))\to f(b)$. If $g$ is continuous at $a$ and $f$ at $g(a)$, then $f\circ g$ is continuous at $a$.

method.title: Separate inner and outer functions
method.body: Check that the inner output belongs to the outer domain.

method.title: Find the inner limit
method.body: For $0/0$, simplify or rationalize first to obtain a finite value $b$.

method.title: Check outer continuity
method.body: Only after checking continuity at $b$, evaluate $f(b)$.

pitfalls: Check the full domain of the composition, not only one output value.
Inverse trigonometric values here are in radians.

concepts.title: 分段衔接与连续参数
concepts.summary: 来自节后习题 39–46：每个分支在内部连续时，只需另外检查衔接点。参数由“左极限 = 函数值 = 右极限”决定。

method.title: 检查分支内部
method.body: 确认各公式在使用区间内有定义且连续。

method.title: 算衔接点三值
method.body: 按严格与非严格条件找到该点所属分支，并分别计算两侧。

method.title: 联立并回代
method.body: 求参数后，在每个衔接点重新验证两侧及函数值。

pitfalls: 衔接点的函数值由包含等号的分支决定。

en.title: Piecewise junctions and parameters
en.summary: Developed in Exercises 39–46: when each branch is continuous inside its interval, check the junctions separately. Determine parameters from left limit = value = right limit.

method.title: Check branch interiors
method.body: Verify each rule is defined and continuous on its assigned interior.

method.title: Compute three junction values
method.body: Use the inequalities to identify the value at the junction and calculate both one-sided limits.

method.title: Solve and substitute back
method.body: Solve the matching equations and recheck all junction values.

pitfalls: The branch containing equality determines the junction value.

concepts.title: 介值定理与根的定位
concepts.summary: 若 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 连续，且 $N$ 严格介于 $f(a)$、$f(b)$，则存在 $c\in(a,b)$ 使 $f(c)=N$。当两端异号时取 $N=0$，得到至少一个根。

method.title: 化为一个连续函数
method.body: 把方程整理成 $F(x)=0$，先确认整个闭区间无缺点、极点或域问题。

method.title: 精确比较端点
method.body: 求 $F(a)$、$F(b)$ 或目标值两侧，明确严格不等式。

method.title: 应用并缩小范围
method.body: 说明存在性；数值近似时继续找异号端点，注明误差或位数。

pitfalls: 异号不能越过不连续点使用介值定理。
定理保证存在，不自动保证唯一。

en.title: The Intermediate Value Theorem and root location
en.summary: If $f$ is continuous on $[a,b]$ and $N$ lies strictly between $f(a)$ and $f(b)$, some $c\in(a,b)$ satisfies $f(c)=N$. Opposite endpoint signs give at least one root by choosing $N=0$.

method.title: Form one continuous function
method.body: Rewrite the equation as $F(x)=0$ and verify continuity on the entire closed interval.

method.title: Compare endpoint values
method.body: Calculate $F(a)$ and $F(b)$ or compare them with the target using strict inequalities.

method.title: Apply and refine
method.body: State existence. For a numerical approximation, narrow a sign-changing bracket and state its precision.

pitfalls: Opposite signs across a discontinuity do not justify the theorem.
Existence does not automatically imply uniqueness.

concepts.title: 连续性证明与反例
concepts.summary: 来自节后习题 59–69：平移变量 $x=a+h$、三角加法公式、夹逼定理及有理数/无理数的稠密性可检验连续性。构造反例时须逐一满足原假设。

method.title: 写清要证的等式
method.body: 连续性目标为 $\lim_{h\to0}f(a+h)=f(a)$。

method.title: 选适用工具
method.body: 用极限定律与具体不等式；区分证明存在与证明连续。

method.title: 核对特殊点和反向命题
method.body: 特殊点单独处理；反向命题失败时写出函数、原结论成立的理由与连续性失败的理由。

pitfalls: 图像或有限个数值不能替代证明。

en.title: Continuity proofs and counterexamples
en.summary: Developed in Exercises 59–69: use $x=a+h$, trigonometric addition formulas, the Squeeze Theorem, and density of rationals and irrationals. A counterexample must satisfy every stated hypothesis.

method.title: State the target
method.body: Continuity means $\lim_{h\to0}f(a+h)=f(a)$.

method.title: Choose the tool
method.body: Use limit laws and explicit inequalities. Distinguish existence proofs from continuity proofs.

method.title: Check special points and converses
method.body: Handle special points separately. For a false converse, exhibit a function and verify both the premise and failure of the claimed conclusion.

pitfalls: A graph or finitely many sampled values cannot replace a proof.

questions.label: 例题 1
questions.prompt: 图 2 给出函数 $f$ 的图像。在哪些数处不连续？为什么？

steps.title: 检查 $x=1$
steps.body: 原图在 $1$ 处只有空心点，$f(1)$ 没有定义，所以不连续。

steps.title: 检查 $x=3$
steps.body: $f(3)$ 有定义，但曲线左右趋近不同高度，双侧极限不存在。

steps.title: 检查 $x=5$
steps.body: 两侧趋近同一个空心点高度，但实心点 $f(5)$ 位于另一高度，故极限不等于函数值。

en.label: Example 1
en.prompt: Figure 2 shows the graph of a function $f$. At which numbers is $f$ discontinuous? Why?

steps.title: Check $x=1$
steps.body: The graph has only an open point at $1$, so $f(1)$ is undefined and continuity fails.

steps.title: Check $x=3$
steps.body: $f(3)$ is defined, but the left and right limits differ, so the two-sided limit does not exist.

steps.title: Check $x=5$
steps.body: Both sides approach the open point, but the filled point $f(5)$ is at another height. The limit differs from the value.

en.answer: $x=1,3,5$. The discontinuities at $1$ and $5$ are removable; at $3$ it is a jump.

questions.label: 例题 2
questions.prompt: 以下函数各在哪些数处不连续？(a) $f(x)=\frac{x^2-x-2}{x-2}$；(b) $f(x)=\begin{cases}1/x^2&x\ne0\\ 1&x=0\end{cases}$；(c) $f(x)=\begin{cases}(x^2-x-2)/(x-2)&x\ne2\\ 1&x=2\end{cases}$；(d) $f(x)=\lfloor x\rfloor$（取整函数）。

steps.title: (a) 找缺失点
steps.body: $x^2-x-2=(x-2)(x+1)$。在 $x\ne2$ 时 $f(x)=x+1$，极限为 $3$；原函数 $f(2)$ 无定义，故在 $2$ 可去间断，其他点连续。

steps.title: (b) 对照无穷行为
steps.body: $f(0)=1$，但 $1/x^2\to+\infty$，不存在有限极限。仅在 $0$ 无穷间断。

steps.title: (c) 比较极限与值
steps.body: $x\ne2$ 时仍为 $x+1$，所以 $\lim_{x\to2}f(x)=3\ne f(2)=1$。仅在 $2$ 可去间断；改为 $f(2)=3$ 可修补。

steps.title: (d) 比较整数两侧
steps.body: 对整数 $n$，左极限为 $n-1$，右极限及函数值为 $n$，故所有整数有跳跃间断。两个相邻整数之间函数为常数，因而连续。

en.label: Example 2
en.prompt: Where are each of the following functions discontinuous? (a) $f(x)=\frac{x^2-x-2}{x-2}$; (b) $f(x)=\begin{cases}1/x^2&x\ne0\\ 1&x=0\end{cases}$; (c) $f(x)=\begin{cases}(x^2-x-2)/(x-2)&x\ne2\\ 1&x=2\end{cases}$; (d) $f(x)=\lfloor x\rfloor$, the greatest integer function.

steps.title: (a) Find the missing point
steps.body: $x^2-x-2=(x-2)(x+1)$. For $x\ne2$, $f(x)=x+1$ and the limit at $2$ is $3$. The original $f(2)$ is undefined, giving a removable discontinuity only at $2$.

steps.title: (b) Check infinite behavior
steps.body: $f(0)=1$, but $1/x^2\to+\infty$, so no finite limit exists. The only discontinuity is infinite, at $0$.

steps.title: (c) Compare limit and value
steps.body: For $x\ne2$ the rule is $x+1$, so $\lim_{x\to2}f(x)=3\ne f(2)=1$. This is removable only at $2$; assigning $f(2)=3$ repairs it.

steps.title: (d) Compare the sides of an integer
steps.body: At an integer $n$, the left limit is $n-1$ and the right limit and value are $n$. Every integer is a jump discontinuity; between consecutive integers the function is constant and continuous.

en.answer: (a) $2$; (b) $0$; (c) $2$; (d) all integers $n\in\mathbb Z$.

questions.label: 例题 3
questions.prompt: 在每个整数 $n$，说明取整函数 $f(x)=\lfloor x\rfloor$ 的单侧连续性。

steps.title: 从右侧趋近
steps.body: $n\le x<n+1$ 时 $f(x)=n$，所以 $\lim_{x\to n^+}f(x)=n=f(n)$。

steps.title: 从左侧趋近
steps.body: $n-1\le x<n$ 时 $f(x)=n-1$，所以 $\lim_{x\to n^-}f(x)=n-1\ne f(n)$。

questions.answer: 每个整数处右连续、左不连续。

en.label: Example 3
en.prompt: At each integer $n$, determine the one-sided continuity of $f(x)=\lfloor x\rfloor$.

steps.title: Approach from the right
steps.body: For $n\le x<n+1$, $f(x)=n$, hence $\lim_{x\to n^+}f(x)=n=f(n)$.

steps.title: Approach from the left
steps.body: For $n-1\le x<n$, $f(x)=n-1$, hence $\lim_{x\to n^-}f(x)=n-1\ne f(n)$.

en.answer: Right continuous and not left continuous at every integer.

questions.label: 例题 4

steps.title: 内部点
steps.body: 若 $-1<a<1$，根号内 $1-a^2>0$。极限定律给出 $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)=1-\sqrt{1-a^2}=f(a)$。

steps.title: 左端点
steps.body: 当 $x\to-1^+$，$0\le1-x^2\to0$。其平方根趋于 $0$（非负数 $u<\epsilon^2$ 时 $\sqrt u<\epsilon$），所以 $f(x)\to1=f(-1)$。

steps.title: 右端点
steps.body: 同理 $x\to1^-$ 时 $\sqrt{1-x^2}\to0$，故 $f(x)\to1=f(1)$。内部连续且端点满足相应单侧连续。

en.label: Example 4
en.prompt: Show that $f(x)=1-\sqrt{1-x^2}$ is continuous on $[-1,1]$.

steps.title: Interior points
steps.body: For $-1<a<1$, $1-a^2>0$. Limit laws give $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)=1-\sqrt{1-a^2}=f(a)$.

steps.title: Left endpoint
steps.body: As $x\to-1^+$, $0\le1-x^2\to0$. Its square root tends to $0$: if $0\le u<\epsilon^2$, then $\sqrt u<\epsilon$. Thus $f(x)\to1=f(-1)$.

steps.title: Right endpoint
steps.body: Similarly, as $x\to1^-$, $\sqrt{1-x^2}\to0$, so $f(x)\to1=f(1)$. Interior continuity and the correct one-sided endpoint conditions establish the claim.

en.answer: Continuous on $[-1,1]$; its graph is the lower semicircle of $x^2+(y-1)^2=1$.

questions.label: 例题 6
questions.prompt: 函数 $f(x)=\frac{\ln x+\tan^{-1}x}{x^2-1}$ 在哪里连续？

steps.title: 分子条件
steps.body: $\ln x$ 要求 $x>0$；$\tan^{-1}x$ 在所有实数上连续。因此分子在 $(0,\infty)$ 连续。

steps.title: 分母与交集
steps.body: $x^2-1=0$ 在 $x=\pm1$。与 $x>0$ 取交集，只需另外排除 $1$；用商的连续性定理。

en.label: Example 6
en.prompt: Where is $f(x)=\frac{\ln x+\tan^{-1}x}{x^2-1}$ continuous?

steps.title: Numerator conditions

exercises.prompt: 写出一个等式，表示函数 $f$ 在 $4$ 处连续。

steps.title: 用连续的定义

en.prompt: Write an equation that expresses the fact that a function $f$ is continuous at the number $4$.

steps.title: Use the definition
steps.body: Continuity requires $f(4)$ to be defined and the limit as $x\to4$ to exist and equal that value.

exercises.prompt: 若 $f$ 在 $(-\infty,\infty)$ 上连续，对它的图像能作出什么判断？

steps.title: 解释每一点的连续性
steps.body: 在每个实数处，图像的左右部分连接到同一个函数值，没有孔洞、跳跃或竖直渐近线造成的断开。

steps.title: 给出图像描述
steps.body: 任取有限区间，图像可以连续地画出而不抬笔；角点允许存在，因为连续不要求光滑。

exercises.answer: 整条图像没有断开；在任一有限区间上可以不抬笔画出。

en.prompt: If $f$ is continuous on $(-\infty,\infty)$, what can you say about its graph?

steps.title: Interpret continuity at each point
steps.body: At each real number, both sides of the graph meet the same function value; there are no holes, jumps, or breaks caused by vertical asymptotes.

steps.title: Describe the graph
steps.body: On every finite interval the graph can be drawn without lifting the pencil. Corners are allowed because continuity does not require smoothness.

en.answer: The graph has no breaks and can be drawn without lifting the pencil on any finite interval.

exercises.prompt: (a) 根据所给 $f$ 的图像，列出 $f$ 不连续的数并说明原因。(b) 对 (a) 中每一个数，判断 $f$ 是右连续、左连续，还是两者都不是。

steps.title: (a) 查找孔洞与断开
steps.body: $x=-4$ 处为空心点，$f(-4)$ 没有定义。在 $x=-2$ 与 $x=2$，两侧曲线趋向不同高度；在 $x=4$，左支向下无界而右支从有限的实心点开始。因此四处都不连续。

steps.title: (b) 比较单侧极限与实心点
steps.body: 在 $-2$，实心点位于左支，所以 $\lim_{x\to-2^-}f(x)=f(-2)$；在 $2$ 与 $4$，实心点位于右支，所以右极限等于函数值。

steps.title: 排除未定义的点
steps.body: $f(-4)$ 未定义，故在 $-4$ 不可能左连续或右连续。

en.prompt: (a) From the graph of $f$, state the numbers at which $f$ is discontinuous and explain why. (b) For each number in part (a), determine whether $f$ is continuous from the right, from the left, or neither.

steps.title: (a) Find holes and breaks
steps.body: At $x=-4$ there is an open point and $f(-4)$ is undefined. At $x=-2$ and $x=2$ the two branches approach different heights. At $x=4$ the left branch falls without bound while the right branch starts at a finite filled point. Thus all four points are discontinuities.

steps.title: (b) Compare one-sided limits with filled points
steps.body: At $-2$ the filled point belongs to the left branch, so $\lim_{x\to-2^-}f(x)=f(-2)$. At $2$ and $4$ the filled point belongs to the right branch, so the right-hand limit equals the function value.

steps.title: Exclude an undefined point
steps.body: Since $f(-4)$ is undefined, $f$ can be continuous from neither side there.

en.answer: (a) $-4,-2,2,4$. (b) Neither at $-4$; left continuous only at $-2$; right continuous only at $2$ and $4$.

exercises.prompt: 根据所给 $g$ 的图像，写出 $g$ 连续的区间。

steps.title: 在断开处划分
steps.body: 图像在 $-2$、$2$、$4$、$6$ 处分成不同曲线段。$x=-2$ 和 $x=6$ 的孤立实心点不与邻近曲线的单侧极限相符；$x=4$ 有竖直渐近线。

steps.title: 核对区间端点
steps.body: $-4$ 是第一支的实心端点，可按右连续包括；$2$ 是下一支的实心端点，也可从右包括。$8$ 为空心点，不能包括。

en.prompt: From the graph of $g$, state the intervals on which $g$ is continuous.

steps.title: Split at the breaks
steps.body: The graph separates into branches at $-2,2,4,6$. The isolated filled points at $-2$ and $6$ do not agree with the nearby one-sided limits, and $x=4$ is a vertical asymptote.

steps.title: Check interval endpoints
steps.body: The filled endpoint at $-4$ is included by right continuity. The filled starting point at $2$ is likewise included from the right. The point at $8$ is open and is excluded.

exercises.prompt: 画一个函数 $f$ 的图像，使它除下述间断外都连续：在 $2$ 处不连续，但右连续。

steps.title: 构造台阶
steps.body: 例如取 $f(x)=0$（$x<2$），$f(x)=1$（$x\ge2$）。每段都是常数函数，段内连续。

steps.title: 检查拼接点
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to2^-}f(x)=0$，$\lim_{x\to2^+}f(x)=1=f(2)$。两侧不相等，因此不连续，但右连续。图上 $(2,0)$ 为空心点，$(2,1)$ 为实心点。

en.prompt: Sketch the graph of a function $f$ that is continuous except for the stated discontinuity: discontinuous, but continuous from the right, at $2$.

steps.title: Construct a step
steps.body: For example, set $f(x)=0$ for $x<2$ and $f(x)=1$ for $x\ge2$. Both constant branches are continuous in their interiors.

steps.title: Check the join
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to2^-}f(x)=0$ and $\lim_{x\to2^+}f(x)=1=f(2)$. The limits differ, so the function is discontinuous but right continuous. Use an open point at $(2,0)$ and a filled point at $(2,1)$.

en.answer: One example is $f(x)=\begin{cases}0&x<2\\ 1&x\ge2.\end{cases}$

en.prompt: Sketch a function $f$ that is continuous except for discontinuities at $-1$ and $4$, but continuous from the left at $-1$ and from the right at $4$.

steps.title: Construct three horizontal branches
steps.body: Set $f(x)=0$ for $x\le-1$, $f(x)=1$ for $-1<x<4$, and $f(x)=2$ for $x\ge4$.

steps.title: Check both joins
steps.body: At $-1$, the left limit is $0=f(-1)$ and the right limit is $1$. At $4$, the left limit is $1$ and the right limit is $2=f(4)$. These give the required one-sided continuity, and each other point lies on a continuous branch.

steps.title: Arrange a jump
steps.body: Also set $f(x)=1$ for $x\ge5$. The limits at $5$ are $0$ and $1$, giving a jump. All other points are continuous.

en.answer: For example, $f(x)=\begin{cases}0&x<5,\ x\ne3\\ 2&x=3\\ 1&x\ge5.\end{cases}$

exercises.prompt: 某段收费公路的通行费 $T$ 为 5 美元，但早上 7 点至 10 点、下午 4 点至晚上 7 点的高峰期为 7 美元。(a) 以午夜后的小时数 $t$ 为横轴画出 $T$ 的图像。(b) 讨论此函数的间断及对使用公路者的意义。

steps.title: (a) 写出时段
steps.body: 一天内 $0\le t\le24$。采用高峰开始时即收费 7 美元、结束时恢复 5 美元的端点约定：$T(t)=7$ 当 $7\le t<10$ 或 $16\le t<19$；其他时间 $T(t)=5$。

steps.title: (b) 比较左右费用
steps.body: 在 $t=7,16$，费用由 $5$ 跳到 $7$；在 $t=10,19$，费用由 $7$ 跳到 $5$。每处跳跃金额为 2 美元。端点的收费约定不会改变这些跳跃位置。

steps.title: 说明实际意义
steps.body: 若可选择通行时间，避开高峰时段可节省 2 美元；在四个切换时间附近，极小的到达时间变化可能改变费用。

en.prompt: The toll $T$ charged for driving on a certain stretch of a toll road is USD 5 except during rush hours (between 7 AM and 10 AM and between 4 PM and 7 PM), when the toll is USD 7. (a) Sketch $T$ as a function of the time $t$, measured in hours past midnight. (b) Discuss the discontinuities and their significance to someone who uses the road.

steps.title: (a) Write the time intervals
steps.body: For one day, $0\le t\le24$. Using the convention that the higher toll starts at the beginning of rush hour and ends at its finishing time, $T(t)=7$ for $7\le t<10$ or $16\le t<19$, and $T(t)=5$ otherwise.

steps.title: (b) Compare the tolls on both sides
steps.body: At $t=7,16$, the toll jumps from USD 5 to USD 7; at $t=10,19$, it jumps from USD 7 to USD 5. Each jump is USD 2. The convention for the exact endpoint does not change these jump locations.

steps.title: Interpret the result
steps.body: A driver who can choose the travel time saves USD 2 outside rush hours. Near a switching time, a very small change in arrival time can change the toll.

en.answer: (a) USD 7 on $[7,10)$ and $[16,19)$, and USD 5 otherwise. (b) Jump discontinuities at $t=7,10,16,19$, each with a USD 2 change.

exercises.prompt: 解释下列每个函数为何连续或不连续：(a) 某一固定地点的温度关于时间的函数；(b) 某一固定时刻的温度关于从纽约市向正西方向距离的函数；(c) 海拔高度关于从纽约市向正西方向距离的函数；(d) 出租车费用关于行驶距离的函数；(e) 房间照明电路中电流关于时间的函数。

steps.title: (a) 温度随时间
steps.body: 通常的物理模型中，温度随时间经过中间值，不瞬时跃变，因而连续。

steps.title: (b) 温度随位置
steps.body: 在固定时刻，空气温度随位置连续变化；变化可以很快，但快速变化本身不等于跳跃。

steps.title: (c) 地形高度
steps.body: 按教材的地形模型，竖直峭壁可造成高度突然改变，所以海拔函数可不连续。若某条路径没有这样的高度跳跃，它也可能连续。

steps.title: (d) 计价器
steps.body: 按分段计费的模型，跨过每个计费距离阈值时费用跳到下一档，产生跳跃间断。

steps.title: (e) 电灯开关
steps.body: 把开关理想化为瞬时切换时，电流在 0 与非零值之间跳跃，因而不连续。实际电路的过渡过程会依具体模型而不同。

exercises.answer: (a)、(b) 连续；(c) 可因峭壁不连续；(d)、(e) 在教材的阶梯计费与理想开关模型中不连续。

en.prompt: Explain why each function is continuous or discontinuous: (a) temperature at a specific location as a function of time; (b) temperature at a specific time as a function of the distance due west from New York City; (c) altitude above sea level as a function of the distance due west from New York City; (d) cost of a taxi ride as a function of the distance traveled; (e) current in the circuit for the lights in a room as a function of time.

steps.title: (a) Temperature over time
steps.body: In the usual physical model, temperature passes through intermediate values as time changes, without instantaneous jumps, so it is continuous.

steps.title: (b) Temperature over position
steps.body: At a fixed time, air temperature changes continuously with location. Rapid variation by itself is not a jump.

steps.title: (c) Terrain height
steps.body: In the textbook terrain model, a vertical cliff can make altitude jump, so the function can be discontinuous. A particular route without such jumps may instead give a continuous function.

steps.title: (d) Taxi meter
steps.body: In the stepped billing model, the fare jumps to the next amount each time a distance threshold is crossed, producing jump discontinuities.

steps.title: (e) Light switch
steps.body: With an ideal instantaneous switch, the current jumps between zero and a nonzero value, so it is discontinuous. A real circuit transient depends on the chosen physical model.

en.answer: (a), (b) continuous; (c) may be discontinuous at cliffs; (d), (e) discontinuous in the textbook stepped-fare and ideal-switch models.

steps.title: 把极限换为函数值
steps.body: 连续性给出 $\lim_{x\to2}f(x)=f(2)$，$\lim_{x\to2}g(x)=6$。用和与积的极限法则，得 $3f(2)+6f(2)=36$。

en.prompt: Suppose $f$ and $g$ are continuous functions such that $g(2)=6$ and $\lim_{x\to2}[3f(x)+f(x)g(x)]=36$. Find $f(2)$.

steps.title: Replace limits by function values
steps.body: Continuity gives $\lim_{x\to2}f(x)=f(2)$ and $\lim_{x\to2}g(x)=6$. The sum and product laws give $3f(2)+6f(2)=36$.

exercises.prompt: 用连续的定义及极限的性质，证明 $f(x)=3x^4-5x+\sqrt[3]{x^2+4}$ 在 $a=2$ 处连续。

steps.title: 应用定义
steps.body: 极限存在且等于已定义的 $f(2)$，所以在 $2$ 处连续。

en.prompt: Use the definition of continuity and the properties of limits to show that $f(x)=3x^4-5x+\sqrt[3]{x^2+4}$ is continuous at $a=2$.

steps.title: Compute the function value
steps.body: The cube root is defined for every real input, and $f(2)=3(2)^4-5(2)+\sqrt[3]{2^2+4}=48-10+2=40$.

steps.title: Apply the limit laws
steps.body: By the sum, constant multiple, power, and cube-root limit laws, $\lim_{x\to2}f(x)=3(2)^4-5(2)+\sqrt[3]{2^2+4}=40$.

steps.title: Apply the definition
steps.body: The limit exists and equals the defined value $f(2)$, so $f$ is continuous at $2$.

en.answer: $\lim_{x\to2}f(x)=40=f(2)$; thus $f$ is continuous at $2$.

exercises.prompt: 用连续的定义及极限的性质，证明 $f(x)=(x+2x^3)^4$ 在 $a=-1$ 处连续。

steps.title: 比较
steps.body: 极限等于 $f(-1)$，符合连续的定义。

en.prompt: Use the definition of continuity and the properties of limits to show that $f(x)=(x+2x^3)^4$ is continuous at $a=-1$.

steps.title: Compute the limit
steps.body: By the sum, constant multiple, and power laws, $\lim_{x\to-1}(x+2x^3)^4=[-1+2(-1)^3]^4=81$.

steps.title: Compare
steps.body: The limit equals $f(-1)$, as required by the definition of continuity.

en.answer: $\lim_{x\to-1}f(x)=81=f(-1)$; thus $f$ is continuous at $-1$.

exercises.prompt: 用连续的定义及极限的性质，证明 $h(t)=\frac{2t-3t^2}{1+t^3}$ 在 $a=1$ 处连续。

steps.title: 应用连续定义
steps.body: $\lim_{t\to1}h(t)=h(1)$，所以在 $1$ 处连续。

en.prompt: Use the definition of continuity and the properties of limits to show that $h(t)=\frac{2t-3t^2}{1+t^3}$ is continuous at $a=1$.

steps.title: Use the quotient law
steps.body: The numerator limit is $2(1)-3(1)^2=-1$, and the denominator limit is $1+1^3=2\ne0$, so $\lim_{t\to1}h(t)=-1/2$.

steps.title: Apply the definition
steps.body: $\lim_{t\to1}h(t)=h(1)$, so $h$ is continuous at $1$.

en.answer: $\lim_{t\to1}h(t)=-\frac12=h(1)$; thus $h$ is continuous at $1$.

exercises.prompt: 用连续的定义及极限的性质，证明 $f(x)=\frac{2x+3}{x-2}$ 在 $(2,\infty)$ 上连续。

steps.title: 计算并比较极限
steps.body: 分母极限 $a-2\ne0$，由商法则，$\lim_{x\to a}\frac{2x+3}{x-2}=\frac{2a+3}{a-2}=f(a)$。

steps.title: 推广到整个区间
steps.body: $a$ 是 $(2,\infty)$ 中的任意点，所以该函数在这个区间上连续。$2$ 不属于所给区间。

en.prompt: Use the definition of continuity and the properties of limits to show that $f(x)=\frac{2x+3}{x-2}$ is continuous on $(2,\infty)$.

steps.title: Choose an arbitrary point
steps.body: Let $a>2$. Then $a-2>0$, so $f(a)$ is defined.

steps.title: Compute and compare the limit
steps.body: The denominator limit is $a-2\ne0$. The quotient law gives $\lim_{x\to a}\frac{2x+3}{x-2}=\frac{2a+3}{a-2}=f(a)$.

steps.title: Conclude on the whole interval
steps.body: Because $a$ was arbitrary in $(2,\infty)$, the function is continuous throughout that interval. The point $2$ is excluded.

en.answer: Continuous on $(2,\infty)$.

exercises.prompt: 用连续的定义及极限的性质，证明 $g(x)=2\sqrt{3-x}$ 在 $(-\infty,3]$ 上连续。

steps.title: 检查定义域和内点
steps.body: 根号要求 $3-x\ge0$，故定义域为 $x\le3$。若 $a<3$，根号内的极限为 $3-a>0$，根式法则给出 $\lim_{x\to a}g(x)=2\sqrt{3-a}=g(a)$。

steps.title: 检查封闭端点
steps.body: 在端点 $3$ 只能从定义域内向左趋近：$\lim_{x\to3^-}2\sqrt{3-x}=0=g(3)$，故在端点左连续。

exercises.answer: 在 $(-\infty,3]$ 上连续；在 $3$ 处左连续。

en.prompt: Use the definition of continuity and the properties of limits to show that $g(x)=2\sqrt{3-x}$ is continuous on $(-\infty,3]$.

steps.title: Check the domain and interior
steps.body: The square root requires $3-x\ge0$, so the domain is $x\le3$. For $a<3$, the radicand tends to $3-a>0$, and the root law gives $\lim_{x\to a}g(x)=2\sqrt{3-a}=g(a)$.

steps.title: Check the closed endpoint
steps.body: At $3$ approach from within the domain, on the left: $\lim_{x\to3^-}2\sqrt{3-x}=0=g(3)$, giving left continuity at the endpoint.

en.answer: Continuous on $(-\infty,3]$, with left continuity at $3$.

exercises.prompt: 说明 $f(x)=\frac1{x+2}$ 为什么在 $a=-2$ 处不连续，并画出图像。

steps.title: 检查函数值
steps.body: 当 $x=-2$ 时分母为零，故 $f(-2)$ 没有定义，已经违反连续的必要条件。

steps.title: 检查左右行为并画图
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to-2^-}f(x)=-\infty$，$\lim_{x\to-2^+}f(x)=+\infty$。画双曲线，竖直渐近线为 $x=-2$，水平渐近线为 $y=0$；定义域是 $\mathbb R\setminus\{-2\}$。

exercises.answer: $-2$ 处为无穷间断；$f(-2)$ 未定义。

en.prompt: Explain why $f(x)=\frac1{x+2}$ is discontinuous at $a=-2$. Sketch its graph.

steps.title: Check the value
steps.body: At $x=-2$ the denominator is zero, so $f(-2)$ is undefined, violating a necessary condition for continuity.

steps.title: Check both sides and sketch
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to-2^-}f(x)=-\infty$ and $\lim_{x\to-2^+}f(x)=+\infty$. Draw a hyperbola with vertical asymptote $x=-2$ and horizontal asymptote $y=0$; the domain is $\mathbb R\setminus\{-2\}$.

en.answer: An infinite discontinuity at $-2$; $f(-2)$ is undefined.

exercises.prompt: 说明 $f(x)=\begin{cases}\frac1{x+2}&x\ne-2\\ 1&x=-2\end{cases}$ 为什么在 $a=-2$ 处不连续，并画出图像。

steps.title: 记录函数值
steps.body: $f(-2)=1$，所以该点已定义。

steps.title: 极限条件仍然失败
steps.body: 去心邻域中仍为 $1/(x+2)$，故左极限为 $-\infty$、右极限为 $+\infty$，没有有限双侧极限，更不等于 $1$。

steps.title: 画出特别点
steps.body: 保留竖直渐近线 $x=-2$ 和水平渐近线 $y=0$ 的双曲线，再加实心点 $(-2,1)$。单独补一个点不能消除无穷间断。

exercises.answer: $-2$ 处不连续，尽管 $f(-2)=1$，两侧无界极限仍不相同。

en.prompt: Explain why $f(x)=\begin{cases}\frac1{x+2}&x\ne-2\\ 1&x=-2\end{cases}$ is discontinuous at $a=-2$. Sketch its graph.

steps.title: Record the value
steps.body: $f(-2)=1$, so the function is defined at the point.

steps.title: The limit condition still fails
steps.body: In a punctured neighborhood the function remains $1/(x+2)$, with left limit $-\infty$ and right limit $+\infty$. There is no finite two-sided limit equal to $1$.

steps.title: Show the special point
steps.body: Draw the hyperbola with asymptotes $x=-2$ and $y=0$, and add the filled point $(-2,1)$. Defining a single point cannot remove the infinite discontinuity.

en.answer: Discontinuous at $-2$: although $f(-2)=1$, the two sides have different unbounded limits.

exercises.prompt: 说明 $f(x)=\begin{cases}e^x&x<0\\ x^2&x\ge0\end{cases}$ 为什么在 $a=0$ 处不连续，并画出图像。

steps.title: 比较
steps.body: 左右极限 $1\ne0$，故在 $0$ 处为跳跃间断，但右连续。两段在其他点都连续，定义域为全体实数。

exercises.answer: $0$ 处跳跃间断，且仅右连续。

en.prompt: Explain why $f(x)=\begin{cases}e^x&x<0\\ x^2&x\ge0\end{cases}$ is discontinuous at $a=0$. Sketch its graph.

steps.title: Left side
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to0^-}e^x=e^0=1$. Use an open point at $(0,1)$ on the left branch.

steps.title: Right side and value
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to0^+}x^2=0=f(0)$. The right branch is a parabola with a filled point at $(0,0)$.

steps.title: Compare
steps.body: The limits differ, $1\ne0$, so there is a jump discontinuity at $0$, with right continuity. Both branches are continuous elsewhere; the domain is all real numbers.

en.answer: A jump discontinuity at $0$, with right continuity only.

exercises.prompt: 说明 $f(x)=\begin{cases}\frac{x^2-x}{x^2-1}&x\ne1\\ 1&x=1\end{cases}$ 为什么在 $a=1$ 处不连续，并画出图像。

steps.title: 因式分解
steps.body: 原分式分母要求 $x\ne-1,1$。对这些 $x$，$\frac{x^2-x}{x^2-1}=\frac{x(x-1)}{(x-1)(x+1)}=\frac{x}{x+1}$。特别定义补入了 $x=1$，但没有补入 $x=-1$。

steps.title: 比较极限与值
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to1}f(x)=\frac1{1+1}=\frac12$，而 $f(1)=1$，因此在 $1$ 处是可去间断。

steps.title: 绘图并检查域
steps.body: 画 $y=x/(x+1)$，在 $(1,1/2)$ 留空心点、在 $(1,1)$ 加实心点；竖直渐近线为 $x=-1$，水平渐近线为 $y=1$。完整定义域为 $\mathbb R\setminus\{-1\}$。

en.prompt: Explain why $f(x)=\begin{cases}\frac{x^2-x}{x^2-1}&x\ne1\\ 1&x=1\end{cases}$ is discontinuous at $a=1$. Sketch its graph.

steps.title: Factor
steps.body: The rational branch requires $x\ne-1,1$. For these values, $\frac{x^2-x}{x^2-1}=\frac{x(x-1)}{(x-1)(x+1)}=\frac{x}{x+1}$. The special definition fills in $x=1$ but not $x=-1$.

steps.title: Compare the limit and value
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to1}f(x)=\frac1{1+1}=\frac12$, whereas $f(1)=1$, so the discontinuity at $1$ is removable.

steps.title: Sketch and check the domain
steps.body: Draw $y=x/(x+1)$ with an open point at $(1,1/2)$ and a filled point at $(1,1)$. Its vertical and horizontal asymptotes are $x=-1$ and $y=1$. The full domain is $\mathbb R\setminus\{-1\}$.

en.answer: $\lim_{x\to1}f(x)=\frac12\ne1=f(1)$; a removable discontinuity at $1$.

exercises.prompt: 说明 $f(x)=\begin{cases}\cos x&x<0\\ 0&x=0\\ 1-x^2&x>0\end{cases}$ 为什么在 $a=0$ 处不连续，并画出图像。

steps.title: 比较实际值
steps.body: $f(0)=0\ne1$，故是可去间断，也不左连续或右连续。

steps.title: 画图
steps.body: 左半轴画余弦曲线，右半轴画 $y=1-x^2$；共同趋近的 $(0,1)$ 留空，实际 $(0,0)$ 画实心。定义域是 $\mathbb R$。

en.prompt: Explain why $f(x)=\begin{cases}\cos x&x<0\\ 0&x=0\\ 1-x^2&x>0\end{cases}$ is discontinuous at $a=0$. Sketch its graph.

steps.title: Compute both one-sided limits
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to0^-}\cos x=1$ and $\lim_{x\to0^+}(1-x^2)=1$, so the two-sided limit is $1$.

steps.title: Compare the actual value
steps.body: $f(0)=0\ne1$, giving a removable discontinuity and continuity from neither side.

steps.title: Sketch
steps.body: Draw the cosine curve on the negative half-axis and $y=1-x^2$ on the positive half-axis. Leave $(0,1)$ open and fill $(0,0)$. The domain is $\mathbb R$.

en.answer: $\lim_{x\to0}f(x)=1\ne0=f(0)$; a removable discontinuity at $0$.

steps.body: 画直线 $y=2x+1$，在 $(3,7)$ 留空心点，在 $(3,6)$ 加实心点；定义域为全体实数。

en.prompt: Explain why $f(x)=\begin{cases}\frac{2x^2-5x-3}{x-3}&x\ne3\\ 6&x=3\end{cases}$ is discontinuous at $a=3$. Sketch its graph.

steps.title: Compare
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to3}f(x)=2(3)+1=7$, whereas $f(3)=6$, so the discontinuity is removable.

steps.title: Sketch
steps.body: Draw the line $y=2x+1$ with an open point at $(3,7)$ and a filled point at $(3,6)$. The domain is all real numbers.

en.answer: $\lim_{x\to3}f(x)=7\ne6=f(3)$; a removable discontinuity at $3$.

exercises.prompt: 如何“去掉” $f(x)=\frac{x^2-x-2}{x-2}$ 的间断？即应怎样定义 $f(2)$，使 $f$ 在 $2$ 处连续？

steps.title: 化简去心邻域中的表达式
用极限补点
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to2}f(x)=2+1=3$。定义 $f(2)=3$ 后，极限就等于函数值。

en.prompt: How would you remove the discontinuity of $f(x)=\frac{x^2-x-2}{x-2}$? In other words, how would you define $f(2)$ in order to make $f$ continuous at $2$?

steps.title: Fill in the point using the limit
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to2}f(x)=2+1=3$. Defining $f(2)=3$ makes the limit equal the function value.

en.answer: Define $f(2)=3$.

exercises.prompt: 如何“去掉” $f(x)=\frac{x^3-8}{x^2-4}$ 在 $2$ 处的间断？即应怎样定义 $f(2)$，使 $f$ 在 $2$ 处连续？

steps.title: 计算极限并补值
steps.body: 在 $2$ 附近新分母趋于 $4\ne0$，故极限为 $(4+4+4)/4=3$。定义 $f(2)=3$，但原分母在 $-2$ 仍为零，那里仍被排除。

exercises.answer: 定义 $f(2)=3$；这只修复 $2$ 处的间断。

en.prompt: How would you remove the discontinuity of $f(x)=\frac{x^3-8}{x^2-4}$ at $2$? In other words, how would you define $f(2)$ in order to make $f$ continuous at $2$?

steps.title: Compute the limit and fill the value
steps.body: Near $2$ the new denominator tends to $4\ne0$, so the limit is $(4+4+4)/4=3$. Define $f(2)=3$; the denominator at $-2$ still vanishes, so $-2$ remains excluded.

en.answer: Define $f(2)=3$; this repairs the discontinuity at $2$ only.

exercises.prompt: 用定理 4、5、7、9 解释下列函数为何在其定义域的每一点连续，并写出定义域：$F(x)=\frac{2x^2-x-1}{x^2+1}$。

steps.title: 检查分母
steps.body: 对每个实数，$x^2+1\ge1>0$，所以定义域为 $\mathbb R$。

steps.title: 应用有理函数定理
steps.body: 分子、分母都是多项式，按定理 5(a) 处处连续；分母不为零，定理 4 的商规则或定理 5(b) 说明 $F$ 处处连续。

exercises.answer: 定义域 $\mathbb R$；在定义域每点连续。

en.prompt: Explain, using Theorems 4, 5, 7, and 9, why the function is continuous at every number in its domain. State the domain: $F(x)=\frac{2x^2-x-1}{x^2+1}$.

steps.title: Check the denominator
steps.body: For every real $x$, $x^2+1\ge1>0$, so the domain is $\mathbb R$.

steps.title: Apply the rational-function theorem
steps.body: The numerator and denominator are polynomials, continuous everywhere by Theorem 5(a). Since the denominator is nonzero, the quotient rule in Theorem 4, or Theorem 5(b), makes $F$ continuous everywhere.

en.answer: Domain $\mathbb R$; continuous at every point of its domain.

exercises.prompt: 用定理 4、5、7、9 解释下列函数为何在其定义域的每一点连续，并写出定义域：$G(x)=\frac{x^2+1}{2x^2-x-1}$。

steps.title: 应用定理
steps.body: 多项式由定理 5(a) 连续，商在分母非零处由定理 4 连续；等价地，定理 5(b) 直接说明有理函数在定义域内连续。

en.prompt: Explain, using Theorems 4, 5, 7, and 9, why the function is continuous at every number in its domain. State the domain: $G(x)=\frac{x^2+1}{2x^2-x-1}$.

steps.title: Apply the theorems
steps.body: Polynomials are continuous by Theorem 5(a), and their quotient is continuous where the denominator is nonzero by Theorem 4. Equivalently, Theorem 5(b) directly gives continuity of a rational function throughout its domain.

en.answer: Domain $(-\infty,-\frac12)\cup(-\frac12,1)\cup(1,\infty)$; continuous throughout.

exercises.prompt: 用定理 4、5、7、9 解释下列函数为何在其定义域的每一点连续，并写出定义域：$Q(x)=\frac{\sqrt[3]{x-2}}{x^3-2}$。

steps.title: 检查域
steps.body: 立方根允许所有实数 $x-2$，但分母要求 $x^3-2\ne0$，即 $x\ne\sqrt[3]{2}$。

steps.title: 检查分子与分母的连续性
steps.body: $x-2$ 和 $x^3-2$ 由定理 5(a) 连续；立方根由定理 7 连续，定理 9 的复合规则说明 $\sqrt[3]{x-2}$ 连续。

steps.title: 检查定义域

steps.body: $x\to0^-$ 时 $1/x\to-\infty$、$e^{1/x}\to0$，所以 $y\to1$。

steps.title: 计算右极限
steps.body: $x\to0^+$ 时 $1/x\to+\infty$、$e^{1/x}\to+\infty$，所以 $y\to0$。左右有限极限不同，$0$ 处是不可去的跳跃间断。

en.prompt: Locate the discontinuities of $y=\frac1{1+e^{1/x}}$ and illustrate by graphing.

steps.title: Check the domain
steps.body: $1/x$ requires $x\ne0$. The exponential is positive, so the denominator never vanishes. Thus the domain is $\mathbb R\setminus\{0\}$, and composition and quotient continuity apply everywhere in that domain.

steps.title: Compute the left limit
steps.body: As $x\to0^-$, $1/x\to-\infty$ and $e^{1/x}\to0$, so $y\to1$.

steps.title: Compute the right limit
steps.body: As $x\to0^+$, $1/x\to+\infty$ and $e^{1/x}\to+\infty$, so $y\to0$. The finite one-sided limits differ, giving a nonremovable jump at $0$.

steps.title: Describe the graph

en.answer: The only discontinuity is at $x=0$: left limit $1$, right limit $0$.

steps.title: 先处理内层未定式
steps.body: 原商的定义域为 $\mathbb R\setminus\{0,2\}$。在 $x\ne0,2$ 时，$\frac{x^2-4}{3x^2-6x}=\frac{(x-2)(x+2)}{3x(x-2)}=\frac{x+2}{3x}$。约分仅用于原函数的穿孔邻域，没有定义原函数在 $2$ 的值。

steps.title: 求内层极限
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to2}\frac{x+2}{3x}=\frac4{6}=\frac23$，因为化简后分母在 $2$ 不为零。

steps.title: 应用反正切连续性
steps.body: $\arctan$ 在所有实数上连续，因此极限为 $\arctan(2/3)\approx0.588003$（弧度）。

en.prompt: Use continuity to evaluate $\lim_{x\to2}\arctan\left(\frac{x^2-4}{3x^2-6x}\right)$.

steps.title: Simplify the inner indeterminate form
steps.body: The original quotient has domain $\mathbb R\setminus\{0,2\}$. For $x\ne0,2$, $\frac{x^2-4}{3x^2-6x}=\frac{(x-2)(x+2)}{3x(x-2)}=\frac{x+2}{3x}$. Cancellation is used only in the original punctured neighborhood; it does not define the original value at $2$.

steps.title: Find the inner limit
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to2}\frac{x+2}{3x}=\frac4{6}=\frac23$, since the simplified denominator is nonzero at $2$.

steps.title: Apply continuity of arctangent
steps.body: Arctangent is continuous on all real numbers, so the limit is $\arctan(2/3)\approx0.588003$ radians.

en.answer: $\arctan\frac23\approx0.588003$ radians.

exercises.prompt: 地球对距地心 $r$ 处单位质量施加的引力为 $F(r)=\begin{cases}\frac{GMr}{R^3},&r<R,\\ \frac{GM}{r^2},&r\ge R,\end{cases}$，其中 $M$ 是地球质量，$R$ 是半径，$G$ 是引力常数。$F$ 是否是 $r$ 的连续函数？

steps.title: 明确物理定义域
steps.body: 作为距离，$r\ge0$；地球半径 $R>0$。第一段是 $r$ 的线性函数，第二段在 $r\ge R>0$ 时分母非零，故两段各自连续。

steps.title: 核对地表连接点
steps.body: $\lim_{r\to R^-}F(r)=\frac{GMR}{R^3}=\frac{GM}{R^2}$，$\lim_{r\to R^+}F(r)=\frac{GM}{R^2}$，并且 $F(R)=\frac{GM}{R^2}$。

steps.title: 核对中心端点
steps.body: $F(0)=0$ 且 $\lim_{r\to0^+}F(r)=0$，因此在物理定义域的左端点右连续。结合连接点和各段，$F$ 在 $[0,\infty)$ 连续。

exercises.answer: 是；在物理定义域 $r\in[0,\infty)$ 上连续，特别在 $r=R$ 两段取同一值 $GM/R^2$。

en.prompt: The gravitational force exerted by Earth on a unit mass at distance $r$ from its center is $F(r)=\begin{cases}\frac{GMr}{R^3},&r<R,\\ \frac{GM}{r^2},&r\ge R,\end{cases}$, where $M$ is Earth's mass, $R$ its radius, and $G$ the gravitational constant. Is $F$ a continuous function of $r$?

steps.title: State the physical domain
steps.body: As a distance, $r\ge0$, and Earth's radius satisfies $R>0$. The first piece is linear in $r$; in the second piece $r\ge R>0$, so its denominator is nonzero. Each piece is continuous.

steps.title: Check the surface junction
steps.body: $\lim_{r\to R^-}F(r)=\frac{GMR}{R^3}=\frac{GM}{R^2}$, $\lim_{r\to R^+}F(r)=\frac{GM}{R^2}$, and $F(R)=\frac{GM}{R^2}$.

steps.title: Check the center endpoint
steps.body: $F(0)=0$ and $\lim_{r\to0^+}F(r)=0$, so it is continuous from the right at the physical domain's left endpoint. Together with the junction and piecewise checks, $F$ is continuous on $[0,\infty)$.

en.answer: Yes. It is continuous on the physical domain $r\in[0,\infty)$; in particular, both pieces match at $r=R$ with value $GM/R^2$.

exercises.prompt: 常数 $c$ 取何值时，$f(x)=\begin{cases}cx^2+2x,&x<2,\\ x^3-cx,&x\ge2\end{cases}$ 在 $(-\infty,\infty)$ 上连续？

steps.title: 建立连接条件
steps.body: 对任意实数 $c$，两段都是多项式，唯一可能的不连续点为 $2$。左极限是 $4c+4$，右极限及函数值是 $8-2c$。

steps.title: 代回验证
steps.body: 当 $c=2/3$ 时，两侧极限和 $f(2)$ 都是 $20/3$，故全域连续；其余 $c$ 不满足连接条件。

en.prompt: For what value of the constant $c$ is $f(x)=\begin{cases}cx^2+2x,&x<2,\\ x^3-cx,&x\ge2\end{cases}$ continuous on $(-\infty,\infty)$?

steps.title: Set the junction condition
steps.body: For every real $c$, both pieces are polynomials, so the only possible discontinuity is at $2$. The left limit is $4c+4$, and the right limit and function value are $8-2c$.

steps.title: Solve the condition
steps.body: Continuity holds exactly when $4c+4=8-2c$, or $6c=4$, giving $c=2/3$.

steps.title: Verify by substitution
steps.body: For $c=2/3$, both limits and $f(2)$ equal $20/3$, proving continuity everywhere. Every other $c$ fails the junction condition.

en.answer: $c=\frac23$, and only this value.

exercises.prompt: 求使 $f$ 处处连续的 $a,b$：$f(x)=\begin{cases}\frac{x^2-4}{x-2},&x<2,\\ ax^2-bx+3,&2\le x<3,\\ 2x-a+b,&x\ge3.\end{cases}$

steps.title: 解方程组
steps.body: 第二式减去第一式的两倍得 $2a=1$，所以 $a=1/2$。代入 $4a-2b=1$ 得 $b=1/2$。

steps.title: 验证全部定义域
steps.body: 第一段分母在 $x<2$ 非零；另外两段是多项式。代入参数后，$2$ 处两段同为 $4$，$3$ 处两段同为 $6$。方程组有唯一解，所以没有其他参数情形。

en.prompt: Find the values of $a$ and $b$ that make $f$ continuous everywhere: $f(x)=\begin{cases}\frac{x^2-4}{x-2},&x<2,\\ ax^2-bx+3,&2\le x<3,\\ 2x-a+b,&x\ge3.\end{cases}$

steps.title: Join at $2$
steps.body: For $x<2$, $\frac{x^2-4}{x-2}=x+2$, so the left limit is $4$. The right limit and $f(2)$ equal $4a-2b+3$, requiring $4a-2b=1$.

steps.title: Join at $3$
steps.body: The left limit is $9a-3b+3$, and the right limit and $f(3)$ are $6-a+b$. Thus $9a-3b+3=6-a+b$, or $10a-4b=3$.

steps.title: Solve the system
steps.body: Subtract twice the first equation from the second to obtain $2a=1$, so $a=1/2$. Substitution into $4a-2b=1$ gives $b=1/2$.

steps.title: Verify the full domain
steps.body: The first denominator is nonzero for $x<2$; the other two pieces are polynomials. With these parameters, both pieces equal $4$ at the junction $2$ and $6$ at the junction $3$. The system has a unique solution, so there are no other parameter cases.

en.answer: $a=b=\frac12$.

exercises.prompt: 下列函数中哪些在 $a$ 处有可去不连续？若可去，求与 $f$ 在 $x\ne a$ 时一致且在 $a$ 连续的函数 $g$。(a) $f(x)=\frac{x^4-1}{x-1}$，$a=1$；(b) $f(x)=\frac{x^3-x^2-2x}{x-2}$，$a=2$；(c) $f(x)=\lfloor\sin x\rfloor$，$a=\pi$（括号表示最大整数函数）。

steps.title: (b) 因式分解
steps.body: 对 $x\ne2$，$\frac{x^3-x^2-2x}{x-2}=\frac{x(x-2)(x+1)}{x-2}=x^2+x$。极限为 $6$，故不连续可去。取 $g(x)=x^2+x$（$x\in\mathbb R$），于是 $g(2)=6$。

steps.title: (c) 比较两侧整数值
steps.body: 在足够靠近 $\pi$ 的左侧，$0<\sin x<1$，故 $\lfloor\sin x\rfloor=0$；右侧有 $-1<\sin x<0$，故 $\lfloor\sin x\rfloor=-1$。因此左右极限分别是 $0$ 和 $-1$，不相等。虽然 $f(\pi)=0$，改变单点值也无法修复跳跃。

en.prompt: Which functions have a removable discontinuity at $a$? If it is removable, find a function $g$ that agrees with $f$ for $x\ne a$ and is continuous at $a$. (a) $f(x)=\frac{x^4-1}{x-1}$, $a=1$; (b) $f(x)=\frac{x^3-x^2-2x}{x-2}$, $a=2$; (c) $f(x)=\lfloor\sin x\rfloor$, $a=\pi$ (the brackets denote the greatest-integer function).

steps.title: (a) Factor
steps.body: For $x\ne1$, $\frac{x^4-1}{x-1}=\frac{(x-1)(x+1)(x^2+1)}{x-1}=x^3+x^2+x+1$. The limit is $4$, while the original value at $1$ is undefined, so the discontinuity is removable. Set $g(x)=x^3+x^2+x+1$ for all real $x$, giving $g(1)=4$.

steps.title: (b) Factor
steps.body: For $x\ne2$, $\frac{x^3-x^2-2x}{x-2}=\frac{x(x-2)(x+1)}{x-2}=x^2+x$. The limit is $6$, so the discontinuity is removable. Set $g(x)=x^2+x$ for all real $x$, giving $g(2)=6$.

steps.title: (c) Compare the integer values on both sides
steps.body: Sufficiently close to $\pi$ on the left, $0<\sin x<1$, so $\lfloor\sin x\rfloor=0$. On the right, $-1<\sin x<0$, so $\lfloor\sin x\rfloor=-1$. The one-sided limits are $0$ and $-1$, hence unequal. Although $f(\pi)=0$, changing a single value cannot remove the jump.

en.answer: (a) Removable: $g=x^3+x^2+x+1$, with $g(1)=4$. (b) Removable: $g=x^2+x$, with $g(2)=6$. (c) Not removable; it is a jump discontinuity.

exercises.prompt: 设 $f$ 在 $[0,1]$ 上除 $0.25$ 外连续，且 $f(0)=1$、$f(1)=3$。令 $N=2$。画出两种可能的 $f$ 图像：一种不满足介值定理的结论；另一种虽不满足定理的假设，仍满足其结论。

steps.title: 构造不取到 $2$ 的例子
steps.body: 在 $[0,1]$ 定义 $f_A(x)=\begin{cases}1,&0\le x\le1/4,\\ 3,&1/4<x\le1.\end{cases}$。其左、右极限在 $1/4$ 分别为 $1,3$，故确实不连续；别处连续且满足两个端点值。值域仅为 $\{1,3\}$，因此没有 $c$ 使 $f_A(c)=2$。

steps.title: 构造仍取到 $2$ 的例子
steps.body: 在 $[0,1]$ 定义 $f_B(x)=\begin{cases}1+2x,&x\ne1/4,\\ 0,&x=1/4.\end{cases}$。在 $1/4$ 的极限为 $3/2$，但函数值为 $0$，所以此处确实不连续；其他点连续。端点为 $1,3$，且 $f_B(1/2)=2$。

steps.title: 核对两张自制示例图
steps.body: 左图按 $f_A$ 绘制，$(1/4,1)$ 实心、$(1/4,3)$ 空心；右图按 $f_B$ 绘制，$(1/4,3/2)$ 空心、$(1/4,0)$ 实心，并标明 $(1/2,2)$。两图均画出水平线 $y=2$。缺少连续性假设使定理无法保证结论，但不意味着结论必定为假。

exercises.answer: 不满足结论的示例：$f_A=1$（$x\le1/4$），$f_A=3$（$x>1/4$）。满足结论的示例：$f_B=1+2x$（$x\ne1/4$），$f_B(1/4)=0$，且 $f_B(1/2)=2$。两图是明确满足原条件的自制示例。

en.prompt: Suppose $f$ is continuous on $[0,1]$ except at $0.25$, with $f(0)=1$ and $f(1)=3$. Let $N=2$. Sketch two possible graphs: one showing that $f$ might not satisfy the conclusion of the Intermediate Value Theorem, and one showing that it might still satisfy the conclusion even though it does not satisfy the hypothesis.

steps.title: Construct an example that never attains $2$
steps.body: On $[0,1]$, define $f_A(x)=\begin{cases}1,&0\le x\le1/4,\\ 3,&1/4<x\le1.\end{cases}$. The left and right limits at $1/4$ are $1$ and $3$, so it really is discontinuous there. It is continuous elsewhere and has the required endpoint values. Its range is only $\{1,3\}$, so no $c$ satisfies $f_A(c)=2$.

steps.title: Construct an example that still attains $2$
steps.body: On $[0,1]$, define $f_B(x)=\begin{cases}1+2x,&x\ne1/4,\\ 0,&x=1/4.\end{cases}$. Its limit at $1/4$ is $3/2$, whereas its value is $0$, so it really is discontinuous there. It is continuous elsewhere, has endpoint values $1,3$, and satisfies $f_B(1/2)=2$.

steps.title: Check the two original example plots
steps.body: The left plot shows $f_A$, with a filled point at $(1/4,1)$ and an open point at $(1/4,3)$. The right shows $f_B$, with an open point at $(1/4,3/2)$, a filled point at $(1/4,0)$, and $(1/2,2)$ marked. Both include $y=2$. Without the continuity hypothesis the theorem does not guarantee its conclusion, but the conclusion can still hold.

en.answer: Failure example: $f_A=1$ for $x\le1/4$ and $f_A=3$ for $x>1/4$. Success example: $f_B=1+2x$ for $x\ne1/4$, with $f_B(1/4)=0$ and $f_B(1/2)=2$. Both original example plots explicitly satisfy the stated conditions.

exercises.prompt: 若 $f(x)=x^2+10\sin x$，证明存在数 $c$ 使 $f(c)=1000$。

steps.title: 应用介值定理
steps.body: $f(0)=0<1000<1014\le f(32)$，所以介值定理保证某个 $c\in(0,32)$ 满足 $f(c)=1000$。这个证明使用精确界，不依赖正弦近似值。

en.prompt: If $f(x)=x^2+10\sin x$, show that there is a number $c$ such that $f(c)=1000$.

steps.title: Choose endpoints with controlled values
steps.body: As a sum of a polynomial and a sine function, $f$ is continuous on $[0,32]$. Also $f(0)=0$, and $\sin32\ge-1$ gives $f(32)=1024+10\sin32\ge1014$.

steps.title: Apply the Intermediate Value Theorem
steps.body: Since $f(0)=0<1000<1014\le f(32)$, the Intermediate Value Theorem gives some $c\in(0,32)$ with $f(c)=1000$. The proof uses exact bounds rather than approximate sine values.

en.answer: There is a $c\in(0,32)$ with $c^2+10\sin c=1000$.

steps.title: 排除相等
steps.body: 因为 $3$ 不是 $f(x)=6$ 的两个解之一，所以 $f(3)\ne6$。

steps.title: 使用唯一解条件
steps.body: 这样的 $c$ 既不是 $1$ 也不是 $4$，与已知矛盾。排除 $f(3)<6$ 和 $f(3)=6$ 后，必有 $f(3)>6$。

en.prompt: Suppose $f$ is continuous on $[1,5]$ and the only solutions of $f(x)=6$ are $x=1$ and $x=4$. If $f(2)=8$, explain why $f(3)>6$.

steps.title: Exclude equality
steps.body: Since $3$ is not one of the two solutions of $f(x)=6$, $f(3)\ne6$.

steps.title: Suppose the value is below $6$
steps.body: If $f(3)<6$, continuity on $[2,3]$ and $f(2)=8>6>f(3)$ yield a $c\in(2,3)$ with $f(c)=6$ by the Intermediate Value Theorem.

steps.title: Use the restriction on solutions
steps.body: That $c$ would be neither $1$ nor $4$, contradicting the given restriction. Since both $f(3)<6$ and $f(3)=6$ are excluded, $f(3)>6$.

exercises.prompt: 利用介值定理证明方程 $x^4+x-3=0$ 在区间 $(1,2)$ 内有根。

steps.title: 建立连续函数
steps.body: 令 $h(x)=x^4+x-3$。这是多项式，在闭区间 $[1,2]$ 连续。

steps.title: 用介值定理定位根
steps.body: $0$ 严格介于两个端点值之间，因此存在 $c\in(1,2)$ 使 $h(c)=0$。

en.prompt: Use the Intermediate Value Theorem to show that $x^4+x-3=0$ has a root in $(1,2)$.

steps.title: Define a continuous function
steps.body: Let $h(x)=x^4+x-3$. This polynomial is continuous on $[1,2]$.

steps.title: Locate a root by the theorem
steps.body: Because $0$ lies strictly between the endpoint values, there is a $c\in(1,2)$ such that $h(c)=0$.

en.answer: At least one root $c\in(1,2)$.

exercises.prompt: 利用介值定理证明方程 $\sqrt[3]{x}=1-x$ 在区间 $(0,1)$ 内有根。

steps.title: 移到等式一侧
steps.body: 令 $h(x)=\sqrt[3]{x}+x-1$。立方根和多项式均连续，所以 $h$ 在 $[0,1]$ 连续。

steps.title: 还原原方程
steps.body: 介值定理给出 $c\in(0,1)$ 使 $\sqrt[3]{c}+c-1=0$，等价于 $\sqrt[3]{c}=1-c$。

en.prompt: Use the Intermediate Value Theorem to show that $\sqrt[3]{x}=1-x$ has a root in $(0,1)$.

steps.title: Move all terms to one side
steps.body: Let $h(x)=\sqrt[3]{x}+x-1$. The cube root and polynomials are continuous, so $h$ is continuous on $[0,1]$.

steps.title: Return to the original equation
steps.body: The Intermediate Value Theorem gives $c\in(0,1)$ with $\sqrt[3]{c}+c-1=0$, equivalently $\sqrt[3]{c}=1-c$.

en.answer: At least one root $c\in(0,1)$.

exercises.prompt: 利用介值定理证明方程 $e^x=3-2x$ 在区间 $(0,1)$ 内有根。

steps.title: 建立连续差函数
steps.body: 令 $h(x)=e^x+2x-3$。指数函数及多项式连续，所以 $h$ 在 $[0,1]$ 连续。

en.prompt: Use the Intermediate Value Theorem to show that $e^x=3-2x$ has a root in $(0,1)$.

steps.title: Define a continuous difference
steps.body: Let $h(x)=e^x+2x-3$. Exponential and polynomial functions are continuous, so $h$ is continuous on $[0,1]$.

steps.title: Apply the Intermediate Value Theorem
steps.body: There is a $c\in(0,1)$ with $h(c)=0$, or $e^c=3-2c$.

en.answer: At least one root $c\in(0,1)$.

exercises.prompt: 利用介值定理证明方程 $\sin x=x^2-x$ 在区间 $(1,2)$ 内有根。

steps.title: 建立连续差函数
steps.body: 令 $h(x)=\sin x-x^2+x$。它是连续函数的和差，在 $[1,2]$ 连续。角度使用弧度。

steps.title: 得到区间内根
steps.body: 介值定理保证 $c\in(1,2)$ 使 $h(c)=0$，于是 $\sin c=c^2-c$。

en.prompt: Use the Intermediate Value Theorem to show that $\sin x=x^2-x$ has a root in $(1,2)$.

steps.title: Define a continuous difference
steps.body: Let $h(x)=\sin x-x^2+x$. It is a sum and difference of continuous functions, hence continuous on $[1,2]$. Angles are in radians.

steps.title: Obtain an interior root
steps.body: The Intermediate Value Theorem guarantees a $c\in(1,2)$ with $h(c)=0$, hence $\sin c=c^2-c$.

en.answer: At least one root $c\in(1,2)$.

exercises.prompt: 证明：$f$ 在 $a$ 连续，当且仅当 $\lim_{h\to0}f(a+h)=f(a)$。

steps.title: 正向：把距离改写为 $|h|$
steps.body: 若 $f$ 在 $a$ 连续，则 $f(a)$ 有定义，且对任意 $\varepsilon>0$ 存在 $\delta>0$，使 $0<|x-a|<\delta$ 时 $|f(x)-f(a)|<\varepsilon$（取 $f$ 定义域内的 $x$）。令 $x=a+h$，则 $|x-a|=|h|$，所以 $0<|h|<\delta$ 时 $|f(a+h)-f(a)|<\varepsilon$。

steps.title: 反向：令 $h=x-a$
steps.body: 反过来，若 $\lim_{h\to0}f(a+h)=f(a)$，则 $f(a)$ 有定义，并对任意 $\varepsilon>0$ 有相应的 $\delta>0$。当 $0<|x-a|<\delta$ 时令 $h=x-a$，于是 $0<|h|<\delta$，且 $|f(x)-f(a)|=|f(a+h)-f(a)|<\varepsilon$。

steps.title: 归结为连续性定义
steps.body: 正向得到 $\lim_{h\to0}f(a+h)=f(a)$；反向得到 $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)=f(a)$，即在 $a$ 连续。两种写法通过同一穿孔邻域的平移完全等价。

exercises.answer: 两条件等价，因为 $x=a+h$ 将 $x\to a$ 与 $h\to0$ 以及两种距离条件一一对应。

en.prompt: Prove that $f$ is continuous at $a$ if and only if $\lim_{h\to0}f(a+h)=f(a)$.

steps.title: Forward direction: rewrite the distance as $|h|$
steps.body: If $f$ is continuous at $a$, then $f(a)$ is defined and, for every $\varepsilon>0$, there is a $\delta>0$ such that $0<|x-a|<\delta$ implies $|f(x)-f(a)|<\varepsilon$ for $x$ in the domain. Set $x=a+h$. Then $|x-a|=|h|$, so $0<|h|<\delta$ implies $|f(a+h)-f(a)|<\varepsilon$.

steps.title: Reverse direction: set $h=x-a$
steps.body: Conversely, if $\lim_{h\to0}f(a+h)=f(a)$, then $f(a)$ is defined, and each $\varepsilon>0$ has a corresponding $\delta>0$. For $0<|x-a|<\delta$, set $h=x-a$. Then $0<|h|<\delta$ and $|f(x)-f(a)|=|f(a+h)-f(a)|<\varepsilon$.

steps.title: Conclude from the definition
steps.body: The forward direction proves $\lim_{h\to0}f(a+h)=f(a)$; the reverse proves $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)=f(a)$, which is continuity at $a$. Translation identifies the same punctured neighborhoods in the two formulations.

en.answer: The conditions are equivalent because $x=a+h$ identifies $x\to a$ with $h\to0$ and preserves the distance conditions.

exercises.prompt: 为证明正弦连续，需要证明对每个实数 $a$，$\lim_{x\to a}\sin x=\sin a$。由第59题，等价于 $\lim_{h\to0}\sin(a+h)=\sin a$。利用本节式(6)证明这一点。

steps.title: 写出已知极限与恒等式
steps.body: 本节式(6)为 $\lim_{h\to0}\cos h=1$、$\lim_{h\to0}\sin h=0$。正弦和角公式给出 $\sin(a+h)=\sin a\cos h+\cos a\sin h$。

steps.title: 应用和与常数倍极限法则
steps.body: 固定 $a$，$\sin a,\cos a$ 是常数。因此 $\lim_{h\to0}\sin(a+h)=\sin a\cdot1+\cos a\cdot0=\sin a$。

steps.title: 使用第59题
steps.body: 由第59题，$\sin x$ 在任意实数 $a$ 连续。这里仅用了 $0$ 处的式(6)，没有预先假设正弦在所有点连续。

exercises.answer: $\sin x$ 在 $\mathbb R$ 上连续。

en.prompt: To prove sine is continuous, show that $\lim_{x\to a}\sin x=\sin a$ for every real $a$. By Exercise 59, this is equivalent to $\lim_{h\to0}\sin(a+h)=\sin a$. Use equation (6) of this section to prove it.

steps.title: State the known limits and identity
steps.body: Equation (6) gives $\lim_{h\to0}\cos h=1$ and $\lim_{h\to0}\sin h=0$. The sine addition formula is $\sin(a+h)=\sin a\cos h+\cos a\sin h$.

steps.title: Apply sum and constant multiple limit laws
steps.body: For fixed $a$, $\sin a$ and $\cos a$ are constants. Hence $\lim_{h\to0}\sin(a+h)=\sin a\cdot1+\cos a\cdot0=\sin a$.

steps.title: Use Exercise 59
steps.body: Exercise 59 proves that sine is continuous at every real $a$. The argument uses only the limits at $0$ in equation (6), without assuming global continuity of sine.

en.answer: Sine is continuous on $\mathbb R$.

exercises.prompt: 证明余弦是连续函数。

steps.title: 利用和角公式
steps.body: 固定任意 $a\in\mathbb R$。$\cos(a+h)=\cos a\cos h-\sin a\sin h$。

steps.title: 只用 $0$ 处的已知极限
steps.body: 本节式(6)给出 $\cos h\to1$、$\sin h\to0$。由差与常数倍法则，$\lim_{h\to0}\cos(a+h)=\cos a\cdot1-\sin a\cdot0=\cos a$。

steps.title: 回到连续性定义
steps.body: 第59题说明此式等价于 $\lim_{x\to a}\cos x=\cos a$。因为 $a$ 任意，余弦在全体实数上连续。

exercises.answer: $\cos x$ 在 $\mathbb R$ 上连续。

en.prompt: Prove that cosine is a continuous function.

steps.title: Use the addition formula
steps.body: Fix any $a\in\mathbb R$. Then $\cos(a+h)=\cos a\cos h-\sin a\sin h$.

steps.title: Use only the known limits at $0$
steps.body: Equation (6) gives $\cos h\to1$ and $\sin h\to0$. The difference and constant multiple laws imply $\lim_{h\to0}\cos(a+h)=\cos a\cdot1-\sin a\cdot0=\cos a$.

steps.title: Return to the definition of continuity
steps.body: By Exercise 59 this is equivalent to $\lim_{x\to a}\cos x=\cos a$. Since $a$ was arbitrary, cosine is continuous on all real numbers.

en.answer: Cosine is continuous on $\mathbb R$.

exercises.prompt: (a) 证明定理4第3部分：若 $f$ 在 $a$ 连续且 $c$ 是常数，则 $cf$ 在 $a$ 连续。(b) 证明定理4第5部分：若 $f,g$ 在 $a$ 连续且 $g(a)\ne0$，则 $f/g$ 在 $a$ 连续。

steps.title: (a) 常数倍
steps.body: 由 $f$ 连续，$\lim_{x\to a}f(x)=f(a)$。常数倍法则给出 $\lim_{x\to a}(cf)(x)=c\lim_{x\to a}f(x)=cf(a)=(cf)(a)$，故 $cf$ 连续。此式对所有实数 $c$ 都成立，包括 $c=0$。

steps.title: (b) 先保证商有定义
steps.body: $g(a)\ne0$。由 $g(x)\to g(a)$，取误差 $|g(a)|/2$，可在足够小邻域得到 $|g(x)-g(a)|<|g(a)|/2$，从而 $|g(x)|>|g(a)|/2>0$。所以商在 $a$ 及该邻域的原定义域内都有定义。

steps.title: (b) 应用商法则
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to a}\frac{f(x)}{g(x)}=\frac{\lim f(x)}{\lim g(x)}=\frac{f(a)}{g(a)}=(f/g)(a)$，所以 $f/g$ 在 $a$ 连续。条件 $g(a)\ne0$ 不可删去，否则商在该点可能没有定义。

exercises.answer: (a) 任意常数 $c$（含 $0$）均成立；(b) 在 $g(a)\ne0$ 的假设下成立。

en.prompt: (a) Prove Theorem 4, part 3: if $f$ is continuous at $a$ and $c$ is constant, then $cf$ is continuous at $a$. (b) Prove Theorem 4, part 5: if $f$ and $g$ are continuous at $a$ and $g(a)\ne0$, then $f/g$ is continuous at $a$.

steps.title: (a) Constant multiple
steps.body: Continuity gives $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)=f(a)$. The constant multiple law yields $\lim_{x\to a}(cf)(x)=c\lim_{x\to a}f(x)=cf(a)=(cf)(a)$, proving continuity. This holds for every real $c$, including $c=0$.

steps.title: (b) Ensure the quotient is defined
steps.body: Since $g(a)\ne0$ and $g(x)\to g(a)$, choose error $|g(a)|/2$. In a sufficiently small neighborhood, $|g(x)-g(a)|<|g(a)|/2$, so $|g(x)|>|g(a)|/2>0$. Thus the quotient is defined at $a$ and throughout the nearby original domain.

steps.title: (b) Apply the quotient law
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to a}\frac{f(x)}{g(x)}=\frac{\lim f(x)}{\lim g(x)}=\frac{f(a)}{g(a)}=(f/g)(a)$, proving continuity at $a$. The condition $g(a)\ne0$ is essential because otherwise the quotient may be undefined there.

en.answer: (a) The claim holds for every constant $c$, including $0$. (b) It holds under the hypothesis $g(a)\ne0$.

exercises.prompt: $f(x)=\begin{cases}0,&x\text{ 是有理数},\\ 1,&x\text{ 是无理数}\end{cases}$ 在哪些 $x$ 值处连续？

steps.title: 利用两类数的稠密性
steps.body: 任意非空实数开区间都含有有理数和无理数。固定任意 $a\in\mathbb R$，无论 $f(a)=0$ 还是 $1$，每个去心邻域内都存在一个与 $a$ 类型相反的 $x$。

steps.title: 直接违反连续性条件
steps.body: 取 $\varepsilon=1/2$。对每个 $\delta>0$，上述 $x$ 可取为 $0<|x-a|<\delta$，但 $|f(x)-f(a)|=1>\varepsilon$。所以不存在满足连续性条件的 $\delta$。

steps.title: 得出任意点结论
steps.body: $a$ 任意，因此函数处处不连续。沿有理数和无理数趋近同一点时，函数值分别为 $0$ 和 $1$，也说明任一点的极限都不存在。

exercises.answer: 没有任何连续点（处处不连续）。

en.prompt: For what values of $x$ is $f$ continuous, where $f(x)=\begin{cases}0,&x\text{ is rational},\\ 1,&x\text{ is irrational}\end{cases}$?

steps.title: Use density of both types of numbers
steps.body: Every nonempty open real interval contains rational and irrational numbers. Fix any $a\in\mathbb R$. Whether $f(a)=0$ or $1$, every punctured neighborhood contains an $x$ of the opposite type.

steps.title: Violate the continuity condition
steps.body: Take $\varepsilon=1/2$. For every $\delta>0$, choose the indicated $x$ with $0<|x-a|<\delta$. Yet $|f(x)-f(a)|=1>\varepsilon$, so no $\delta$ meets the continuity condition.

steps.title: Conclude at every point
steps.body: Because $a$ was arbitrary, the function is discontinuous everywhere. Rational and irrational approaches to the same point give values $0$ and $1$, also showing that no limit exists at any point.

en.answer: There are no continuity points; the function is discontinuous everywhere.

exercises.prompt: $g(x)=\begin{cases}0,&x\text{ 是有理数},\\ x,&x\text{ 是无理数}\end{cases}$ 在哪些 $x$ 值处连续？

steps.title: 在 $0$ 用夹逼
steps.body: 对每个实数 $x$，$-|x|\le g(x)\le|x|$。两端在 $x\to0$ 时都趋于 $0$，故 $\lim_{x\to0}g(x)=0=g(0)$，所以在 $0$ 连续。

steps.title: 排除非零有理点
steps.body: 若 $a\ne0$ 是有理数，则 $g(a)=0$。任取 $\delta>0$，可在 $0<|x-a|<\min(\delta,|a|/2)$ 内取无理数 $x$。此时 $|g(x)-g(a)|=|x|>|a|/2$，所以取 $\varepsilon=|a|/2$ 可见不连续。

steps.title: 排除非零无理点
steps.body: 若 $a\ne0$ 是无理数，则 $g(a)=a$。任意去心邻域都有有理数 $x$，此时 $|g(x)-g(a)|=|0-a|=|a|>|a|/2$。故非零无理点也不连续。

en.prompt: For what values of $x$ is $g$ continuous, where $g(x)=\begin{cases}0,&x\text{ is rational},\\ x,&x\text{ is irrational}\end{cases}$?

steps.title: Use squeezing at $0$
steps.body: For every real $x$, $-|x|\le g(x)\le|x|$. Both bounds tend to $0$ as $x\to0$, so $\lim_{x\to0}g(x)=0=g(0)$, proving continuity at $0$.

steps.title: Exclude nonzero rational points
steps.body: If $a\ne0$ is rational, $g(a)=0$. For any $\delta>0$, density gives an irrational $x$ with $0<|x-a|<\min(\delta,|a|/2)$. Then $|g(x)-g(a)|=|x|>|a|/2$, so the continuity condition fails for $\varepsilon=|a|/2$.

steps.title: Exclude nonzero irrational points
steps.body: If $a\ne0$ is irrational, $g(a)=a$. Every punctured neighborhood contains rational $x$, for which $|g(x)-g(a)|=|0-a|=|a|>|a|/2$. Thus nonzero irrational points are also discontinuities.

en.answer: Continuous only at $x=0$.

exercises.prompt: 是否存在一个数，恰好比它自己的立方大 $1$？
exercises.answer: 存在，至少一个这样的实数位于 $(-2,-1)$。

en.prompt: Is there a number that is exactly $1$ more than its cube?

steps.title: Write an equation
steps.body: The required number satisfies $x=x^3+1$, equivalently $h(x)=x^3-x+1=0$.

steps.title: Choose endpoints of opposite signs
steps.body: The polynomial $h$ is continuous on $[-2,-1]$. We have $h(-2)=-8+2+1=-5<0$ and $h(-1)=-1+1+1=1>0$.

steps.title: Use the Intermediate Value Theorem
steps.body: There is a $c\in(-2,-1)$ with $c^3-c+1=0$, hence $c=c^3+1$, exactly as required.

en.answer: Yes; at least one such real number lies in $(-2,-1)$.

exercises.prompt: 若 $a,b$ 均为正数，证明方程 $\frac{a}{x^3+2x^2-1}+\frac{b}{x^3+x-2}=0$ 在区间 $(-1,1)$ 内至少有一个解。

steps.title: 保留分母条件
steps.body: 记 $P(x)=x^3+2x^2-1$、$Q(x)=x^3+x-2$。原方程只在 $P(x)Q(x)\ne0$ 时有定义；它在 $(-1,1)$ 内有极点，不能直接在整个区间对原有理函数使用介值定理。

steps.title: 对连续分子使用介值定理
排除第一分母并还原方程
steps.body: 若 $P(c)=0$，则 $H(c)=aQ(c)<0$，与 $H(c)=0$ 矛盾，所以 $P(c)\ne0$。于是 $\frac{a}{P(c)}+\frac{b}{Q(c)}=\frac{aQ(c)+bP(c)}{P(c)Q(c)}=0$。这证明获得的是原方程的合法解，而非乘分母产生的伪解。

exercises.answer: 存在合法解 $c\in(0,1)\subset(-1,1)$，且两个分母都不为零。

en.prompt: If $a$ and $b$ are positive, prove that $\frac{a}{x^3+2x^2-1}+\frac{b}{x^3+x-2}=0$ has at least one solution in $(-1,1)$.

steps.title: Retain denominator restrictions
steps.body: Set $P(x)=x^3+2x^2-1$ and $Q(x)=x^3+x-2$. The original equation requires $P(x)Q(x)\ne0$. The rational function has a pole inside $(-1,1)$, so the Intermediate Value Theorem cannot be applied to it over the entire interval.

steps.title: Apply the theorem to a continuous numerator
steps.body: Let $H(x)=aQ(x)+bP(x)=(a+b)x^3+2bx^2+ax-(2a+b)$. This continuous polynomial has $H(0)=-(2a+b)<0$ and $H(1)=2b>0$. Therefore there is a $c\in(0,1)\subset(-1,1)$ with $H(c)=0$.

steps.title: Exclude the first denominator and return to the equation
steps.body: If $P(c)=0$, then $H(c)=aQ(c)<0$, contradicting $H(c)=0$. Thus $P(c)\ne0$, and $\frac{a}{P(c)}+\frac{b}{Q(c)}=\frac{aQ(c)+bP(c)}{P(c)Q(c)}=0$. The root is therefore a valid solution of the original equation rather than an extraneous root introduced by clearing denominators.

en.answer: There is a valid solution $c\in(0,1)\subset(-1,1)$ at which both denominators are nonzero.

exercises.prompt: 证明 $f(x)=\begin{cases}x^4\sin(1/x),&x\ne0,\\ 0,&x=0\end{cases}$ 在 $(-\infty,\infty)$ 上连续。

steps.title: 检查非零点
steps.body: 在 $x\ne0$ 时，$1/x$ 连续，正弦与其复合连续，再与多项式 $x^4$ 相乘仍连续。因此只需检查 $0$。

steps.title: 夹逼振荡项
steps.body: 对 $x\ne0$，$-1\le\sin(1/x)\le1$。由于 $x^4\ge0$，有 $-x^4\le x^4\sin(1/x)\le x^4$。

steps.title: 极限等于点值
steps.body: 当 $x\to0$ 时，两端极限都是 $0$。夹逼定理给出 $\lim_{x\to0}f(x)=0=f(0)$，所以在 $0$ 连续，进而全域连续。

exercises.answer: $f$ 在整个 $\mathbb R$ 上连续。

en.prompt: Show that $f(x)=\begin{cases}x^4\sin(1/x),&x\ne0,\\ 0,&x=0\end{cases}$ is continuous on $(-\infty,\infty)$.

steps.title: Check nonzero points
steps.body: For $x\ne0$, $1/x$ is continuous, its composition with sine is continuous, and multiplication by the polynomial $x^4$ preserves continuity. Only $0$ remains to be checked.

steps.title: Squeeze the oscillating term
steps.body: For $x\ne0$, $-1\le\sin(1/x)\le1$. Since $x^4\ge0$, $-x^4\le x^4\sin(1/x)\le x^4$.

steps.title: Match the limit to the value
steps.body: Both bounds tend to $0$ as $x\to0$. The Squeeze Theorem gives $\lim_{x\to0}f(x)=0=f(0)$, proving continuity at $0$ and consequently on the entire real line.

en.answer: $f$ is continuous on all of $\mathbb R$.

exercises.prompt: (a) 证明绝对值函数 $F(x)=|x|$ 处处连续。(b) 证明若 $f$ 在一个区间上连续，则 $|f|$ 也在该区间上连续。(c) (b) 的逆命题是否成立，即 $|f|$ 连续是否推出 $f$ 连续？若成立给出证明，若不成立给出反例。

steps.title: (a) 反三角不等式
steps.body: 对任意实数 $a,x$，$\big||x|-|a|\big|\le|x-a|$。给定 $\varepsilon>0$，取 $\delta=\varepsilon$；若 $|x-a|<\delta$，则 $|F(x)-F(a)|<\varepsilon$。故 $F$ 在任意 $a$ 连续，包括 $a=0$。

steps.title: (b) 把 $f$ 的连续性传给 $|f|$
steps.body: 设 $a$ 属于该区间。由 $f$ 连续，对任意 $\varepsilon>0$ 可使 $|f(x)-f(a)|<\varepsilon$。又有 $\big||f(x)|-|f(a)|\big|\le|f(x)-f(a)|$，故 $|f|$ 在 $a$ 连续。区间端点只取区间内的单侧趋近，同一不等式仍适用。

steps.title: (c) 构造反例
steps.body: 取 $f(x)=\begin{cases}-1,&x<0,\\ 1,&x\ge0.\end{cases}$。此时 $|f(x)|=1$ 处处连续，但 $\lim_{x\to0^-}f(x)=-1$、$\lim_{x\to0^+}f(x)=1$，所以 $f$ 在 $0$ 不连续。

exercises.answer: (a) $|x|$ 处处连续；(b) 连续的 $f$ 的绝对值在同一区间连续，包括按单侧定义的端点；(c) 逆命题不成立，符号跳跃函数是反例。

en.prompt: (a) Show that the absolute-value function $F(x)=|x|$ is continuous everywhere. (b) Prove that if $f$ is continuous on an interval, so is $|f|$. (c) Is the converse in (b) true: does continuity of $|f|$ imply continuity of $f$? Prove it or give a counterexample.

steps.title: (a) Reverse triangle inequality
steps.body: For any real $a,x$, $\big||x|-|a|\big|\le|x-a|$. Given $\varepsilon>0$, choose $\delta=\varepsilon$. Then $|x-a|<\delta$ implies $|F(x)-F(a)|<\varepsilon$, proving continuity at every $a$, including $0$.

steps.title: (b) Transfer continuity to the absolute value
steps.body: Let $a$ belong to the interval. Continuity of $f$ makes $|f(x)-f(a)|<\varepsilon$ for sufficiently close $x$. Since $\big||f(x)|-|f(a)|\big|\le|f(x)-f(a)|$, $|f|$ is continuous at $a$. At interval endpoints, use the one-sided approach within the interval; the same inequality applies.

steps.title: (c) Give a counterexample
steps.body: Take $f(x)=\begin{cases}-1,&x<0,\\ 1,&x\ge0.\end{cases}$. Then $|f(x)|=1$ is continuous everywhere, but $\lim_{x\to0^-}f(x)=-1$ and $\lim_{x\to0^+}f(x)=1$, so $f$ is discontinuous at $0$.

en.answer: (a) $|x|$ is continuous everywhere. (b) The absolute value of a continuous $f$ is continuous on the same interval, including its endpoints with one-sided continuity. (c) The converse is false; the sign-jump function is a counterexample.

exercises.prompt: 一位西藏僧人早上7:00离开寺院，沿通常的山路上山，晚上7:00到达山顶。第二天早上7:00从山顶出发，沿同一路径下山，晚上7:00回到寺院。利用介值定理证明：存在路径上的一点，他在两天恰好同一时刻都经过该点。

steps.title: 用沿路径位置建模
steps.body: 令路径总长度为 $L>0$，$t\in[0,12]$ 为早上7:00之后的小时数。以从寺院沿这条路径量出的距离为位置坐标，分别记两天位置为 $u(t),d(t)$。行走的位置随时间连续；停留或速度变化不破坏连续性。

steps.title: 应用介值定理并解释位置
steps.body: 存在 $t_0\in(0,12)$ 使 $H(t_0)=0$，即 $u(t_0)=d(t_0)$。因为坐标沿同一条路径量取，坐标相同意味着路径上的点相同；这对应两天均在早上7:00之后 $t_0$ 小时到达该点。

exercises.answer: 存在 $t_0\in(0,12)$，使两天在同一时刻（早上7:00之后 $t_0$ 小时）经过同一个路径位置。

en.prompt: A Tibetan monk leaves the monastery at 7:00 AM, takes his usual path up the mountain, and arrives at 7:00 PM. The next morning he starts from the top at 7:00 AM, follows the same path back, and reaches the monastery at 7:00 PM. Use the Intermediate Value Theorem to show that he crosses some point on the path at exactly the same time of day on both days.

steps.title: Model position along the path
steps.body: Let the path length be $L>0$, and let $t\in[0,12]$ measure hours after 7:00 AM. Use distance along this particular path from the monastery as the position coordinate. Denote the two days' positions by $u(t)$ and $d(t)$. Walking gives continuous positions in time; stops or changes in speed preserve continuity.

steps.title: Form a continuous difference
steps.body: $u(0)=0$, $u(12)=L$, $d(0)=L$, and $d(12)=0$. The difference $H(t)=u(t)-d(t)$ is continuous on $[0,12]$, with $H(0)=-L<0$ and $H(12)=L>0$.

steps.title: Apply the theorem and interpret the position
steps.body: There is a $t_0\in(0,12)$ with $H(t_0)=0$, so $u(t_0)=d(t_0)$. Equal coordinates along the same path specify the same point. On both days the monk reaches that point $t_0$ hours after 7:00 AM.

en.answer: There is a $t_0\in(0,12)$ at which the monk crosses the same path position on both days, at the same time of day: $t_0$ hours after 7:00 AM.
